thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Billing/metering: token_count delta > 2x baseline (00:15 window). Incident created INC-2026-0452. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift

maria_infra: Seeing burst of overage flags and customer alerts tied to token counts. Patterns point to proxy cluster-3. @sam_oncall can you pick up pager?

sam_oncall: I'm on pager, joining quick triage call (5m).

josh_sre: I pulled the emitter logs from proxy-3 — lots of retry loops spamming the emitter with duplicate payloads. Example trace: 
```
2026-03-17T05:11:23Z proxy-3 emit retry id=abc123 attempts=5 status=200
2026-03-17T05:11:24Z proxy-3 emit retry id=abc123 attempts=6 status=200
```
Duplicates make the metering aggregator count tokens twice.

maria_infra: Confirmed: queue shows replay window starting ~05:10 UTC; backlog spike correlates with customer overage flags. This looks like transient proxy retry bug after last deploy.

sam_oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable aggressive retry loop on proxy-3 (temp) 2) pause billing auto-charge runs for 1h 3) silence customer overage alerts and send CS a note. I'll action 1 now.

kevin_billing: Pausing auto-charge run and silencing overage alerting. Putting hold on any billing finalization for impacted window. Need list of affected customers for manual review.

anita_cs: Drafting customer-facing message. Short and apologetic, clarify no confirmed charges yet and we're correcting counts. Will paste copy here for approval.

sam_oncall: Pushed disable on retry loop to proxy-3 (hotfix), service restarted. Monitoring token_count and emitter success rate.

incident-bot: Metric check at 05:28 UTC — token_count delta reduced to ~1.1x baseline. Alerts auto-muted.

maria_infra: Downstream aggregator still has backlog entries; running a dedupe job to reconcile duplicate emits before we compute final usage. This may take ~20–30m.

kevin_billing: I'll run a shadow reconciliation against today's invoice snapshot once Maria posts affected IDs. No customer will be auto-billed while hold is active.

maria_infra: Query for top affected customers (example):
```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_spike
FROM meter_emits
WHERE emitted_at BETWEEN '2026-03-17T05:08:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T05:30:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tokens_spike DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
Attaching CSV of top 50 in #secure-attachments (link: /files/att-12345).

anita_cs: Customer blurb (for approval):
"We detected a transient metering issue that caused duplicate usage counts to appear in some accounts between 05:08–05:30 UTC. We have paused billing and corrected the counts; no customer invoices will be impacted. We're investigating the root cause and will follow up with details and any remediation. Apologies for the disruption."

dave_prod: Note: this started right after proxy v2 rollout at 05:05 UTC. We should mark rollout as suspect and gate further deployments until RCA.

josh_sre: Agree on RCA: implement idempotent emitter keys and backpressure on retry loop. I'll own the follow-up ticket.

sam_oncall: Handing off pager to @josh_sre at 06:00 UTC—I'll be OOO after that. Created follow-up: INC-2026-0452-1 (root cause + long-term fixes).

josh_sre: Taking over watch. Reconciliation still running, monitoring logs and billing shadow results.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0452 marked MITIGATED at 05:45 UTC (SEV3 -> monitoring). Please file postmortem in /incidents/INC-2026-0452 within 48h.

maria_infra: Mitigation summary: hotfixed proxy retry behavior, ran dedupe reconciliation, billing hold applied. Next steps: full postmortem, deploy idempotency fix, add alert to detect emitter duplicates earlier.

kevin_billing: Confirmed no auto-charges executed; will send holding note to finance and affected CS reps.

anita_cs: Sending approved customer message now.

sam_oncall: Thanks team — closing my watch.

josh_sre: I'll own the follow-up and postmortem. Adding notes and timeline to the ticket now.

incident-bot: Page closed (automated)."
